home.dating-apps-monetize-your-lonelines: Dating apps monetize your loneliness: blurred likes, paid boosts, countdown timers. Binder refuses the whole playbook — no fake locks, no artificial daily wall and no paid tier. Just two people who actually picked each other.
home.everything-in-the-app-is: Everything in the app is free. Forever. That is the roadmap.
home.nobody-can-message-you-before: Nobody can message you before both of you said yes.
home.your-exact-location-and-birth: Your exact location and birth date never reach another user.
home.no-paywall-no-blurred-likes: NO PAYWALL · NO BLURRED LIKES · NO BOOSTS · NO ADS · NO TRACKERS · MUTUAL ONLY ·

home.matching-is-the-start-not: Matching is the start, not the product.
home.binder-is-intentionally-focused-ide: Binder is intentionally focused: identity, discovery, mutual matching, conversation, safety, settings and profile control. There is no Pro plan, paid boost or artificial feature lock in the product roadmap.
home.age-preferences-and-distance-are: Age, preferences and distance are evaluated server-side for both people — not just yours. Exact coordinates never enter another client’s payload.
home.a-bind-or-pass-is: A Bind or Pass is written before the card leaves the screen. Two simultaneous likes become exactly one match — never zero, never two.
home.only-members-of-an-active: Only members of an active match can read or send messages. Unmatch and block end the conversation at the server, not just on your screen.
home.your-voice-up-to-a: Your voice, up to a minute.
home.voice-messages-in-chat-and: Voice messages in chat and an optional voice intro on your profile. Recordings live in private storage: a message reaches the two people in that conversation, an intro reaches whoever may already see your profile — nobody else, ever.
home.height-smoking-drinking-drugs-exerc: Height, smoking, drinking, drugs, exercise, diet, beliefs, children, wanting children, a car — every one optional, every one filterable. Filters work both ways, so a like never lands in nothing. Your zodiac sign is calculated, never stored.
home.an-app-that-respects-your: An app that respects your attention.
home.every-feature-ships-with-the: Every feature ships with the boring parts finished: moderation, quiet hours, lock-screen privacy. Because “we’ll add that later” is how people get hurt.
home.your-gallery-supports-up-to: Your gallery supports up to six images with explicit ordering — and every new photo passes moderation before anyone else sees it.
home.push-that-sleeps-when-you: Push that sleeps when you do.
home.quiet-hours-are-enforced-on: Quiet hours are enforced on the server, per category, in your timezone. A match at 3 a.m. waits politely until morning.
home.binder-never-puts-message-text: Binder never puts message text on your lock screen. “Open Binder to continue the conversation” — that’s all anyone standing next to you will read.
home.in-your-language-from-the: In your language, from the first screen.
home.binder-follows-the-language-your: Binder follows the language your phone is already set to — 15 of 15 languages are translated in full, and you can override the choice at any time in the app.
home.all-languages-and-how-they: All languages and how they are chosen

privacy.description-what-binder-collects: What Binder collects and what it never exposes: no exact location, no birth date shared, no ad trackers, optional diagnostics off by default.
privacy.what-binder-needs-and-what: What Binder needs — and what it does not expose.
privacy.this-policy-describes-binder-s: This policy describes Binder’s current beta architecture, including first-party ranking measurement and optional technical diagnostics.
privacy.other-binder-users-do-not: Other Binder users do not receive your raw birth date or exact latitude/longitude. Binder derives age and rounded distance server-side. Binder does not use third-party advertising analytics in the current beta.
privacy.authentication-identifiers-such-: authentication identifiers such as email and Supabase Auth metadata.
privacy.birth-date-and-current-location: birth date and current location used to enforce 18+ access and discovery distance.
privacy.first-name-bio-gender-interests: first name, bio, gender, interests, profile photos and messages you choose to create.
privacy.height-smoking-drinking-drug-use: height, smoking, drinking, drug use, exercise, diet, beliefs, whether you have children, whether you want children, and whether you have a car. Every one of these is optional, you choose each answer from a fixed list, you can clear any of them at any time, and a question you leave unanswered is simply not shown.
privacy.beliefs-religion-or-worldview-is: Beliefs (religion or worldview) is a special category of personal data under Article 9 GDPR.
privacy.binder-processes-it-only-because: Binder processes it only because you volunteer it by choosing an answer, and only to show it on your profile and to match against other people's filters — never for advertising, scoring or any other purpose. Your zodiac sign is shown on your profile but never stored: the server derives it from your birth date each time your profile is read.
privacy.the-attribute-filters-you-set: the attribute filters you set are stored with your discovery preferences. They work in both directions — somebody whose filters exclude you does not appear in your deck either, so a like cannot land in nothing.
privacy.voice-messages-you-record-in: voice messages you record in a chat, and the optional voice intro on your profile. Recordings run up to sixty seconds, are stored in private buckets, and are never public files: a voice message can be heard only by the two people in that conversation, a voice intro only by people who may already view your profile. Moderators can listen to a recording only when it has been reported or is referenced by a message under review. Deleting a voice intro removes it; deleting your account removes your recordings.
privacy.blocks-reports-report-context-sn: blocks, reports, report context snapshots, moderation state and abuse-control events.
privacy.an-expo-push-token-may: an Expo push token may be stored only if notifications are enabled in a configured build.
privacy.binder-can-record-the-accounts: Binder can record the accounts involved in a discovery impression, rank position, shared-interest count, a coarse 10-km distance bucket and the later Bind/Pass result. Exact coordinates, profile text, message text and media paths are not copied into this ranking measurement.
privacy.if-you-explicitly-enable-beta: if you explicitly enable Beta Diagnostics, Binder may record a fixed technical event or screen name, duration, a small count, success/error outcome, Android/iOS and app version. This channel does not accept free-form metadata, profile/message content, exact location, contact data, raw exception messages or stack traces.
privacy.enforce-adult-only-onboarding-an: enforce adult-only onboarding and discovery preferences;
privacy.calculate-candidate-eligibility-: calculate candidate eligibility and rounded distance;
privacy.store-and-deliver-matched-conver: store and deliver matched conversations, including voice messages;
privacy.show-the-optional-attributes-you: show the optional attributes you volunteered and match them against the filters other people set;
privacy.prevent-abuse-investigate-report: prevent abuse, investigate reports and enforce blocks;
privacy.measure-whether-discovery-orderi: measure whether discovery ordering and the core matching funnel work;
privacy.diagnose-beta-load-time-or: diagnose beta load-time or render problems when optional diagnostics are enabled;
privacy.operate-account-deletion-and-sec: operate account deletion and security controls.
privacy.core-ranking-and-funnel-measurem: Core ranking and funnel measurement is generated by Binder’s own server from product actions and remains private from other users. Optional client diagnostics are separate and start disabled. You can enable or disable them in
privacy.disabling-them-deletes-the-exist: . Disabling them deletes the existing optional client-diagnostic rows for your account.
privacy.current-retention-targets-are-30: Current retention targets are 30 days for optional client diagnostics and 90 days for discovery ranking observations. Private beta feedback and content-free server funnel records may be kept for up to 180 days while the beta is evaluated.
privacy.binder-currently-uses-supabase-f: Binder currently uses Supabase for authentication, Postgres data, private file storage, realtime delivery and first-party beta measurement. Expo infrastructure may be used for remote notifications when production push is enabled. Binder does not sell personal data to advertisers.
privacy.confirmation-sign-in-and-passwor: confirmation, sign-in and password mails are delivered by Brevo (Sendinblue SAS, France) on Binder's behalf, from
privacy.brevo-therefore-processes-your-e: . Brevo therefore processes your email address and the delivery status of those mails. Brevo adds its own open and click measurement to transactional mail and does not offer a way to switch it off; Binder runs it in anonymised mode, so opens and clicks are not tied back to an individual recipient. This is delivery infrastructure, not advertising or profiling: nothing from it reaches the app, another user, or any third party.
privacy.binder-requests-microphone-acces: Binder requests microphone access only at the moment you start a recording, and only for that recording. There is no background listening, no automatic recording and no transcription. If you deny the permission, everything else in the app keeps working — voice is optional throughout.
privacy.binder-requests-foreground-locat: Binder requests foreground location for discovery. Exact coordinates are stored privately for server-side distance checks and are not returned to another user. Ranking measurement uses a coarse 10-km distance bucket instead of copying exact coordinates. Background location is not part of the current product.
privacy.when-you-request-account-deletio: When you request account deletion, Binder is designed to remove account-associated product data, authentication identity and account-linked beta measurement through database cascade. Certain safety or fraud-prevention records may need limited retention where legally justified; retained records should be minimized and separated from normal product use.
privacy.or-the-in-app-account: or the in-app account controls to initiate deletion.
privacy.you-can-update-profile-informati: You can update profile information in the app, answer or clear any optional attribute, record, replace or delete your voice intro, deny microphone permission, deny location permission, disable push notifications, enable or disable optional Beta Diagnostics, submit private beta feedback, block or report another user, unmatch, and request account deletion.

terms.terms-community-rules-binder-datin: Terms & Community Rules — Binder Dating App
terms.description-binder-terms-18-only: Binder terms: 18+ only, consent and respect rules, prohibited content, voice recording rules, moderation and account deletion. Free product, no paid tier.
terms.mutual-interest-does-not-remove: Mutual interest does not remove boundaries.
terms.these-rules-apply-before-you: These rules apply before you create a Binder profile, upload a photo or send a message.
terms.do-not-use-binder-if: Do not use Binder if you are under 18, and do not misrepresent your age or identity.
terms.you-may-not-use-binder: You may not use Binder to threaten, harass, stalk, shame, intimidate or pressure another person. A match is permission to start a conversation, not permission for sexual conduct, persistent contact or offline access.
terms.sexual-exploitation-or-abuse-of: sexual exploitation or abuse of children, grooming, or any sexualized content involving minors;
terms.sexually-explicit-or-pornographic-: sexually explicit or pornographic profile content;
terms.credible-threats-incitement-to-vio: credible threats, incitement to violence, hate or targeted harassment;
terms.non-consensual-intimate-imagery-or: non-consensual intimate imagery or sexual coercion;
terms.impersonation-deceptive-identity-c: impersonation, deceptive identity claims, scams, fraud or coordinated spam;
terms.sale-facilitation-or-promotion-of: sale, facilitation or promotion of illegal goods or activity;
terms.publishing-another-person-s-privat: publishing another person’s private information without permission;
terms.attempts-to-bypass-blocks-moderati: attempts to bypass blocks, moderation, rate limits or account restrictions.
terms.voice-messages-and-the-profile: Voice messages and the profile voice intro follow the same rules as every other thing you publish here: your own voice, no recordings of other people without their agreement, nothing sexual, threatening or hateful. A voice intro is visible on your profile the moment you save it — there is no pre-approval queue, so the reporting route is the safeguard. Report a recording and a moderator can listen to it and remove it, and a removed recording cannot simply be set again.
terms.you-are-responsible-for-content: You are responsible for content you upload or send. Use images you have the right to use. Do not include misleading claims that materially misrepresent who you are.
terms.binder-may-provide-report-block: Binder may provide report, block, unmatch, rate-limit and moderation controls. We may preserve relevant evidence snapshots when a safety report is submitted and may restrict or remove content or accounts to protect users and the service.
terms.content-may-be-queued-limited: Content may be queued, limited, rejected or removed. Accounts may be suspended for credible safety concerns, repeated violations or attempts to evade enforcement. Serious illegal or child-safety matters may require escalation consistent with applicable law.
terms.you-can-request-deletion-from: You can request deletion from the app or from Binder’s
terms.data-that-must-legitimately-be: . Data that must legitimately be retained for safety, fraud prevention or legal compliance will be minimized and handled separately from ordinary product use; the
terms.describes-exactly-what-is-kept: describes exactly what is kept and for how long.
terms.binder-is-under-active-development: Binder is under active development. Features can change, and availability is not guaranteed. Binder is designed as a free product; there is no Pro plan, paid boost or paid feature tier in the current product roadmap.

safety.toward-child-sexual-abuse-and: toward child sexual abuse and exploitation. The following standards are enforced in the product and in our moderation practice.
safety.binder-is-an-18-service: Binder is an 18+ service. The age requirement is enforced at sign-up through a mandatory birth-date check, and the declared birth date is locked afterwards. Google Play's target audience for Binder is adults only.
safety.the-following-lead-to-immediate: The following lead to immediate removal and account suspension:
safety.any-sexual-content-involving-or: any sexual content involving or depicting minors, real or simulated;
safety.attempts-by-minors-to-access: attempts by minors to access the service or by adults to impersonate minors;
safety.grooming-solicitation-or-sexualiz: grooming, solicitation or sexualized communication directed at minors;
safety.sharing-requesting-or-linking-to: sharing, requesting or linking to child sexual abuse material (CSAM).
safety.every-profile-and-every-message: Every profile and every message can be reported directly in the app — including before a match exists. The report category "May be under 18" is assigned the
safety.in-our-moderation-queue-reporting: in our moderation queue. Reporting also blocks the reported account immediately for the reporting user, and reporters remain anonymous to the reported person.
safety.every-profile-photo-is-reviewed: Every profile photo is reviewed before it becomes visible to other users. Content indicating a minor or CSAE leads to rejection, account suspension and case escalation.
safety.5-action-on-knowledge-and: 5. Action on knowledge and cooperation with authorities
safety.when-we-obtain-actual-knowledge: When we obtain actual knowledge of CSAM or CSAE activity, we remove the content, suspend the account, preserve evidence as legally required and report to the competent authorities — in Germany the Bundeskriminalamt (BKA) and, where applicable, the US National Center for Missing & Exploited Children (NCMEC). We comply with applicable child-safety laws, including reporting obligations.

delete-account.description-request-delet: Request deletion of your Binder account and data — in the app or by email, even after uninstalling. What is removed and what is minimally retained.
delete-account.you-do-not-need-to: You do not need to reinstall Binder to request deletion. The external path below is available even when you no longer have the app.
delete-account.send-the-request-from-the: Send the request from the email address associated with your Binder account when possible. Do not send identity documents, passwords or payment information.
delete-account.your-request-is-matched-t: Your request is matched to the Binder account.
delete-account.the-product-account-is-de: The product account is deactivated so it stops appearing in discovery and active conversations.
delete-account.account-associated-produc: Account-associated product data and authentication identity are deleted through the deletion workflow.
delete-account.if-a-narrowly-defined-saf: If a narrowly defined safety, fraud-prevention or legal record must be retained, it is minimized and kept outside normal product use as described in the privacy policy.
delete-account.binder-will-never-ask-for: Binder will never ask for your password in a deletion request. If account ownership cannot be verified safely, we may ask for a confirmation from the account email address.
delete-account.signed-in-users-can-also: Signed-in users can also start deletion from Binder’s Profile → Account controls. The public resource remains available for people who have uninstalled or lost access to the app.
delete-account.response-times-can-depend: Response times can depend on account verification and legitimate retention requirements. This page is the designated public deletion resource for Binder.
